programme.title: UFO Chronicles
programme.desc: Project Hessdalen: For decades, mysterious lights have appeared over Norway's Hessdalen Valley, drawing scientists and researchers in search of answers. (S1, ep 7)

programme.title: UFO Chronicles
programme.desc: Triangular Craft: After a close encounter with a mysterious triangular craft, Colin Saunders uncovers strikingly similar sightings and chilling paranormal links. (S1, ep 8)

programme.title: UFO Chronicles
programme.desc: The Coyame Incident: A mysterious mid-air collision sparks one of Mexico's most chilling UFO tales, where a recovered object leaves more questions than answers. (S1, ep 9)

programme.title: UFO Chronicles
programme.desc: The Peni Military Base Incident: In 1971, three soldiers witness a strange green light and a towering figure. Later, they report seeing a UFO leaving the area. (S1, ep 10)

programme.title: Pawn Stars

programme.title: Storage Wars Texas
programme.desc: Raiders Of The Lost Arkana: The buyers go to Texarkana in search of new territory. Slick Vic uncovers some action figures and Ricky and Bubba find an unforgettable antique. (S5, ep 1)

programme.title: Storage Wars

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: Perm-Anently Fullerton: Barry takes Dusty under his wing at a big Auction in Fullerton as Rene makes some dainty discoveries. (S15, ep 4)

programme.title: Ancient Aliens 17

programme.title: UFOs Declassified

programme.title: UFOs Declassified

programme.title: American Pickers

programme.title: Dickinson's Real Deal

programme.title: Orangutan Jungle School

programme.title: Wild Tales From The Farm

programme.title: Orangutan Jungle School
